name: instagrambot-monorepo
description: Production-ready Multi-tenant Instagram AI Bot SaaS Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run --workspace=packages/types build && npm run --workspace=packages/config build && npm run --workspace=packages/database build && npm run --workspace=packages/meta build && npm run --workspace=packages/ai build
scripts.build:apps: npm run --workspace=apps/api build && npm run --workspace=apps/web build
